fact: The ICT ministry's page on the Last Mile County Connectivity Project says Phase I, in 2012-2013, connected 28 counties plus Nairobi for voice and data into the national private governmental voice and data network (NOFBI), and Phase 2, completed in 2017, connected the 18 remaining counties and three more towns; it says 'counties', does not name county government offices, and Phases 4 and 5, started in 2022, target further sites within county headquarters and government sites in sub-counties.
title: Last Mile County Connectivity Project (LMCCP)
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy
